parts.text:
To log into your Microsoft OneDrive account, follow these simple steps depending on the device you are using:

### 1. On a Web Browser (Computer or Mobile)
1. Go to the official OneDrive login page: **[onedrive.live.com](https://onedrive.live.com)**.
2. Click the **Sign in** button in the top right corner.
3. Enter the email address, phone number, or Skype name associated with your Microsoft account (e.g., @outlook.com, @hotmail.com, or your personal/work email) and click **Next**.
4. Enter your password and click **Sign in**. 
*Note: If you have two-step verification enabled, you will need to approve the login via your authenticator app or enter a code sent to your phone/email.*

---

### 2. On a Windows PC
OneDrive is built directly into Windows 10 and Windows 11.
1. Click the **OneDrive icon** (a blue or white cloud) in your Windows taskbar (usually located in the system tray at the bottom right, near the clock). 
   * *If you don't see it, search for "OneDrive" in your Windows Start menu and open the app.*
2. Click **Sign in**.
3. Enter your Microsoft account email and password, then follow the on-screen prompts to set up your sync folder.

---

### 3. On a Mac
1. Open the **OneDrive** app. (If you don't have it installed, you can download it from the Mac App Store).
2. Enter your Microsoft account credentials.
3. Choose a folder location for your OneDrive files and complete the setup.

---

### 4. On a Mobile Device (iPhone, iPad, or Android)
1. Download the free **Microsoft OneDrive** app from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store.
2. Open the app and tap **Sign in**.
3. Enter your Microsoft account email and password to access your files.

***

**Having trouble logging in?**
* **Forgot Password?** On the sign-in screen, click **Forgot password?** or **Can't access your account?** to reset your password.
* **Work or School Accounts:** If you are trying to log in with an account provided by your employer or school, make sure to select "Work or school account" if prompted, as this uses a different login portal than personal accounts.
